release_focus.switch_rule: Switch to 0.33.1 only after 0.33.0 has a synchronized final integration PR, green required checks, resolved CodeRabbit findings, clean artifact scan, and target-host validation recorded separately.

hard_invariants: Only one writer lease may be active for a task.
Only one reviewer/remediator lease may be active for a task.
reviewer.agent must not equal writer.agent unless emergency_self_review is explicitly enabled.
All task state transitions must carry head_sha and lease_fence.
GitHub labels/comments mirror state but are not the sole source of authority.
Validators are deterministic gates; agents consume their output and remediate.

planned_0_33_1_mvp.source_of_truth: serialized coordinator state file or external lease store
